rows.behavior: The APM package and the wheel carry the extract-claims skill and the kmctl-claims-extractor agent, whose front matter sets model: haiku and tools Read and Bash.
rows.fails_when: the skill or agent is missing from the package or wheel, or the agent's model is not haiku or its tools differ

rows.behavior: Every kmctl command the skill and the agent name exists in the CLI.
rows.fails_when: the skill or agent names a kmctl command or flag the CLI does not have

rows.behavior: The skill tells the main agent to delegate to the extractor and keep only its summary; the agent's instructions say it runs kmctl audit claims todo and submit, re-asks refused sections, writes only through kmctl audit claims, never edits .okf/, docs/ or a verified stamp, and returns a short summary (sections, claims by kind, refusals).
rows.fails_when: the skill has the main agent read or submit claims itself, or the agent's instructions lack the write-only-through-kmctl rule or the summary shape

rows.behavior: The skill's skill-creator evals ran and their results are recorded in evals/results.md.
rows.fails_when: evals/evals.json or evals/results.md is missing, or results.md records no run

rows.behavior: kmctl plugin patch translates the extractor for Antigravity with view_file and run_command and without commandExecutionPolicy off, and for OpenCode; the auditor's translations are unchanged.
rows.fails_when: translation refuses the extractor, the Antigravity agent lacks run_command or has commandExecutionPolicy off, or the auditor's translated output changes

rows.behavior: The briefing stays within its token budget with the new skill listed.

The manifesto narrows I2 to the kmctl-auditor and the CI action's audit, adds a Value that the claims and checks agents write only through kmctl audit claims and kmctl audit checks, names the skill and agent in its Parts, and a decision record cites spike agent-audit-claims/1 with the rejected alternatives (MCP-only tools, Claude Code-only restriction, file handoff); the architecture overview's Depicts entry for I2 matches.
rows.fails_when: I2 still claims every audit agent has no shell, the Value is missing, the decision record does not cite the spike, or the overview's I2 entry disagrees with the manifesto

rows.behavior: kmctl check and the strict OKF validation pass on the changed .okf/ concepts and docs/ pages, with every touched concept named in .okf/log.md.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits nonzero, or the pre-commit OKF validation reports an error on .okf/
rows.command: uv run kmctl check && just lint

rows.behavior: The repository's own gates stay green: lint, types and the full default test suite.
rows.fails_when: just lint or just test exits nonzero
